properties.displayName: Identity - Non-Interactive Sign-in from Threat Intelligence IP
properties.description:
DETECTS
A non-interactive sign-in, meaning a token refresh, originating from an IP matching an active threat intelligence indicator.

WHY IT MATTERS
Covers the blind spot left by interactive-only TI matching. An attacker who steals a refresh token never produces an interactive sign-in again, so a rule watching only SigninLogs goes quiet while the intrusion continues. This is the companion detection that keeps visibility on a stolen-token session (MITRE T1078, Valid Accounts).

TRIAGE
1. Treat a match here as strongly indicative of token theft rather than password compromise.
2. Identify the resource being accessed to understand what data the token reaches.
3. Compare against the user interactive sign-in IPs. Divergence confirms the session is not the legitimate user.
4. Revoke refresh tokens. A password reset alone does not invalidate an existing refresh token in all cases.
5. Audit all activity by that account across AuditLogs and AzureActivity.

FALSE POSITIVES
Same considerations as the interactive TI rule: stale indicators and shared egress infrastructure. The non-interactive path is additionally noisy where service accounts route through commercial hosting.

SOURCE
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, ThreatIntelIndicators
properties.query:
let TIIps = ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where ObservableKey == "ipv4-addr:value"
    | where IsActive == true
    | distinct ObservableValue;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where IPAddress in (TIIps)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, AppDisplayName, ResourceDisplayName, UserAgent
| extend Account = UserPrincipalName, IP = IPAddress

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Token refresh from malicious IP {{IPAddress}} for {{UserPrincipalName}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Non-interactive sign-in for {{UserPrincipalName}} from {{IPAddress}}, matching an active threat intelligence indicator. Resource {{ResourceDisplayName}}.
